cards.title: SMS OTP login and registration
cards.detail: Customers log in with a 6-digit SMS code (password still available) and verify their mobile by SMS when signing up. Codes last 5 minutes, 5 wrong tries, resend after 30 seconds. Your SMS key and template are saved; the gateway accepts them. Until NetworkZ enables sending, the code is shown on screen for testing.
cards.waitingOn: On hold (your decision). NetworkZ must enable the transactional route on account nswebsitetrg (error 412); the code shows on screen until then.

decisions.text: Delivery charge below ₹500 is ₹50
Cash on Delivery extra charge is ₹50
Maximum Cash on Delivery order is ₹5,000
Beauty products are non-returnable unless damaged or wrong
Delivery and COD charges not refunded on normal returns (refunded if our mistake)
Exchanges only for same-or-lower-priced sizes/colours of the same product
Shipping booked by hand with any courier; tracking typed into admin
Cancellation allowed only before the order is shipped
Maximum 5 units per size/colour per order
Customers must log in to check out (no guest checkout)
No coupons in version 1.0
Review edits allowed within 30 days and checked again
Delivery estimate "4–7 business days" across India
Your web address (domain), e.g. shopme.in
Business contact details, WhatsApp, address, logo
"Remember me" keeps customers logged in 30 days; otherwise until the browser closes
Up to 10 saved addresses; 50 items in a cart; 200 in a wishlist
Refunds started within 2 business days; return requests reviewed within 2 business days
Prepaid orders that come back undelivered are refunded in full
Accounts unused for 3 years may be deleted after 48 hours’ notice
Proprietor and Grievance Officer named on the policies (RESHMA PR)
Return pickup is free for the customer
Razorpay test keys (added and checked)
Use India Post pincode lookup to fill city and state (approved)
GitHub repository link (to protect production online)
Security upgrade of Vite and React Router: yes (done)
SMS OTP: login opens on SMS code with password optional; registration verifies mobile by SMS code and sets a password
SMS OTP limits: 5-minute code, 5 wrong tries, resend after 30 s, 5 codes per number per hour
SMS Access Token Key and approved template text (template 1707174177501770137, ending NETSYS)
Ask NetworkZ to enable the transactional SMS route for account nswebsitetrg (header NETSYS, template 1707174177501770137)
Emails sent from your Gmail for now; automatic WhatsApp messages postponed
Gmail App Password for shopmesupport2@gmail.com (to switch on real emails)
